title: Vavaki veMbiru Dzakakwirira
intro: Unomira pamberi pematongo eguta rekare rakanaka kwazvo, mbiru dzaro refu dzawa. Mhepo inovhuvhuta mumigwagwa isina chinhu, ichitakura ndangariro dzevanhu vane simba vakambotonga nyika idzi. Vaiva vanaani?
clues: Taiva vanhu vane simba guru nehunyanzvi, tichizivikanwa nezvivakwa zvedu zvikuru uye nebudiriro yepamusoro.
Taigara munyika ine mirwi yejecha nemakomo ane matombo, uye taitenda kuti hapana aigona kutikunda.
Mutumwa akauya kwatiri kubva pakati pehama dzedu, achitidana kuti tinamate Allah chete, asi takamuramba uye takamuseka.
Takazvikudza tichiti, ‘Ndiani ane simba kupfuura isu?’ uye takaramba tichizvikudza uye tichinamata zvifananidzo.
Allah vakatumira mhepo ine simba kwazvo yakavhuvhuta kwehusiku hunomwe nemazuva masere, ichiparadza zvese.
Taiva vanhu ve'Ad, vavaki veIram, uye mugumo wedu wakazova yambiro kune vese vakazotevera.

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
